circuit.role: 1.8 V bus segment pull-ups (on the low side of the level shifter)
INT pull-up, only if INT is used

logic: 1.8 V ONLY: VIH 1.26 V, VIL 0.54 V; INT is open drain to be pulled to 1.8 V (p6, p8). Needs the 1.8 V bus segment behind the level shifter.

strap: LDR, GPIO, INT left open (INT cannot be read by a 3.3 V expander input: 1.8 V is below its 0.7 x 3.3 V threshold); poll over I2C

placement: Under the clear window, aperture facing out. ams asks for an achromatic bulk diffuser directly above the aperture (p60, 11.3); the test diffuser sits on the package surface (p15 note).
Not under the infrared-only window of the rangefinders; keep the VL53 emitters from shining into it (separate windows or a wall between).
Top side of the board, same window as the OPT4001.
notes: Flicker detection uses the same chip (dedicated flicker channel); no extra pin.
The only I2C part in the set that needs 1.8 V bus levels.
unverified: Absolute maximum on SCL/SDA/INT: the table row was cut in the text extraction (p7). Assumed NOT 3.3 V tolerant.
